adjudication.rationale: In `store.js.es6` the new plural-hydration branch does `const hydrated = obj[k].map(...)` and then assigns `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = hydrated || []`. Since `Array#map` always returns an array, `hydrated` is never falsy, making `|| []` dead code. Also, because the mapping does not filter out failed `_lookupSubType(...)` results, missing embedded records would become `undefined` elements in the resulting array. This is a real, diff-grounded robustness issue, but the diff alone doesn’t prove missing lookups occur in practice.
